[RDSC.5a.1] Series backend atoms describe the runtime state
the engine must allocate for the observation triples on a
series declaration per [LSER.13]. Each atom declares one
runtime backend keyed by `(schema_name, slot_name,
identity_slot_name)`. One author-level series declaration
may emit one or more backend atoms depending on which
triples appear and which aggregations are referenced — see
[RDSC.5a.2].
